initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-17710. FHIR-39486 later decided not to rename log to trace, instead documenting that log serves the same purpose as FHIRPath trace(). Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current mapping-language source shows log (value) embedded in a source statement, gives the log ([expression]) syntax, shows both log ('not handled yet') and log (src.field), and explains execution order and output; adding more prose would be redundant rather than a necessary reconciliation fix.
